request.note: No payload. The handler reads no field. Observer sockets only.

responses.name: Generated map
responses.when: The character is on a generated map (a dream cave floor), and this socket has not received that floor yet. One event per 12,000 characters of the floor JSON, before `new_map`.

fields.name: run
fields.description: The key of the cave run.

fields.name: index
fields.description: The number of this chunk, from 0.

fields.name: count
fields.description: How many chunks there are.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Part of the JSON text `{run, floors, manifest}`. Join the `text` of all chunks in order, then parse it.

confirm.note: A headless socket gets geometry with empty tile lists and `navigation` (node/logic/generated_maps.js:191-204)

responses.name: Success
responses.when: The observer moved to the character. `y` is 120 px below the character for a desktop socket.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The map of the instance.

fields.name: in
fields.description: The instance of the character.

fields.name: x
fields.description: The `x` of the character.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The `y` of the character, plus 120 for a desktop socket.

fields.name: direction
fields.description: Always 0.

fields.name: effect
fields.description: Always 0.

fields.name: info
fields.description: `instance.info`: extra state of the instance (for example a duel or the tavern).

fields.name: m
fields.description: Always 0: an observer has no map-change counter.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Everything in view, in the format of the `entities` event (`send_all_xy` with `raw`).

confirm.note: `socket.desktop` is `true` unless the socket connected with `secret` and without `desktop`

failures.intro: No check sends a reply. The cave-pause refusal does not apply: an observer socket has no character.

rows.when: The socket is not an observer (no `observers[socket.id]`). An observer exists after `loaded` on a socket without a character.
The observer follows no character, or the character disconnected (`player.dc`). An observer follows a character only when the socket connected with the `secret` handshake query of that character.
The instance of the character does not exist.
The character is on a generated map, and the socket did not connect with `map_protocol=1` (`generated_protocol`).

also.when: Generated map only, with the `map_chunk` events: after the chunks, one for each chest of the cave run on that floor (`cave_send_chests`).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The chest id.

fields.name: x
fields.description: The x position of the chest.

fields.name: y
fields.description: The y position of the chest.

fields.name: map
fields.description: The floor: `zone_<run>_<n>` (node/logic/dream_layout.js:1229).

fields.name: chest
fields.description: The sprite: `"cavechest"` for a cave chest.

fields.name: items
fields.description: The number of item stacks in the chest.

confirm.live_needed: Which chests a run has, and where, is live state.

also.when: Before `new_map`: one for each entity that the observer saw before and does not see at the new place (`send_all_xy` re-baselines the view).

fields.name: id
fields.description: The entity that left the view.

fields.name: outside
fields.description: Always `true`: the entity is out of view, it did not die.

order: generated map only: `map_chunk` events to you, then a `drop` for each chest of the floor
`disappear` `{id, outside: true}` for each entity no longer in view
